sentences.text: Shri Rashid Suhail Sidiqi - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Ajeet Rawat- G.A. for the respondent/State.
 Order

This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in jail since 18.04.2025 in connection with Crime No.09/2025 registered at P.S.
Raisen, District- Raisen for the offence punishable under Sections 376 of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant established physical relation with unmarried prosecutrix aged 24 years.
On account of which, prosecutrix got pregnant and resultantly died due to complications arising out of pregnancy.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 18.04.2025.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is a case of consensual relationship.
Prosecutrix did not lodge any repot against the applicant during her lifetime.
There is no dying declaration of prosecutrix.
If prosecution case is accepted in toto, then, no offence under Section 376 of IPC is made out.
No purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the bar.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore,
it has been prayed that the applicant be released on NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:25348 2 MCRC-20555-2025 bail pending the trial.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

sentences.text: 6. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.

9 . Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
10.
M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
11. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) V. JUDGE L.R.
